notes: Freedom Australia (SAP Commerce/Hybris + Spartacus Angular SPA; product data client-rendered via a Coveo headless commerce widget, per prior Home-Decor pass notes/181.md). robots.txt has no Claude/anthropic-specific disallow, only generic path exclusions unrelated to category browsing. Checked categorysitemap.xml (235 URLs) for bestseller-type terms: exactly one match, /c/best-selling (matched 3x due to duplicate sitemap entries, same URL). No 'top-sellers', 'popular', 'customer-favorites', 'trending' nodes found in the sitemap or main nav (SOFAS/DINING & KITCHENS/LIVING ROOM & OFFICE/BEDROOM/MATTRESSES/OUTDOOR/HOMEWARES/RUGS/WALL ART/LIFESTYLE/SALE) — Bestsellers is a single undifferentiated top-level listing, not nested under any of those verticals, so a single row is emitted (no genuine sub-structure). Direct HTTP fetch confirmed the URL is live (200) with a distinct SSR title ('Best Selling Furniture & Homewares Online in Australia | Freedom') but, consistent with notes/181.md, no product count appears in the SSR shell (Coveo widget renders client-side only). Escalated to Playwright/CDP (tier 2): rendered the page, intercepted network responses, and captured the site's own Coveo commerce/v2/listing API response with pagination.totalProducts=906, which matches the rendered page's own '906 PRODUCTS' filter-bar text exactly. No need for Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3).

rows.evidence: Rendered page text '906 PRODUCTS' in the filter/sort bar; corroborated by Coveo commerce/v2/listing API JSON response field pagination.totalProducts = 906
